correctness.rationale: The proof handles every exponent. The \(p\)-adic valuation descent is derived directly, the \(e>p\) regime grows strictly, and \(e=p\) is fixed. value.rationale: Prime powers are the canonical fixed family, so determining whether they can occur in the next low-period equations is structurally motivated. The theorem completely closes this natural family for the first two iterate orders beyond the published period-two analysis and rules prime powers out of all nontrivial exact period-\(3\) and period-\(4\) cycles.
